content.user_title: Deploy Web Frameworks on Cloudflare Workers
content.value_statement: Framework deployments need adapters and tooling that match the project and rendering mode. This skill guides Cloudflare Workers setup while preserving existing configuration and checking builds.
actual_capabilities: Guide repository inspection to identify the framework, version, package manager, rendering mode, adapter, and Cloudflare configuration.
Route new projects through framework guides and existing projects through Wrangler or cf according to their configuration.
Select framework-specific references for TanStack Start, React Router, SvelteKit, Hono, Astro, Nuxt, and React or Vue SPAs.
Distinguish static output, client-only SPAs, and server rendering when choosing Workers deployment approaches.
Direct integration changes toward adapters, runtime settings, build scripts, and deployment configuration, followed by build and local verification.
Guide redacted skill feedback drafts and require approval of the exact issue text before public submission.
limitations: This skill provides instructions and references, not bundled deployment scripts or framework templates.
Current compatibility details require consulting external framework and Cloudflare documentation.
Next.js setup and some CLI workflows rely on separate skills that are not included here.
Successful deployment still depends on project compatibility, installed tooling, Cloudflare access, and passing builds.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Existing Framework App
use_cases.description: Identify the rendering mode and required integration changes before adapting a framework application for Workers.

use_cases.title: Maintain Wrangler-Based Deployments
use_cases.description: Keep established Wrangler configuration while reviewing adapter changes and validating framework builds locally.

use_cases.title: Start a Framework Project
use_cases.description: Choose the matching Workers framework guide and creation workflow without switching frameworks or selecting Pages templates.

prompt_templates.title: Identify the Deployment Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect my repository without changing files. Identify the framework, rendering mode, package manager, and Cloudflare configuration. Recommend the matching Workers setup path.

prompt_templates.title: Create a SvelteKit Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help create a SvelteKit project for Cloudflare Workers using the current framework guide. Confirm the creation command before running it. Verify the adapter and build.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: start a new framework application.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt an Existing Astro Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Astro project for Workers deployment. Determine whether it is static or on-demand. Preserve existing tooling and propose minimal integration changes before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Review React Router Compatibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my React Router app for Workers compatibility. Determine its mode and version constraints. Preserve Wrangler configuration. Propose changes, then verify builds and runtime locally.

output_examples.input: My SvelteKit repository already has Wrangler configuration. Which setup route applies?
output: Keep Wrangler as the deployment tool and use its companion skill.
Check the Workers framework guide and confirm the Cloudflare adapter configuration.
Run framework checks and the build, then verify the Worker locally before deployment.

output_examples.input: Should my fully prerendered Astro site use an adapter for on-demand rendering?
output: A fully prerendered site deploys as static assets on Workers.
Use the Cloudflare adapter when the application requires on-demand rendering.
Confirm the rendering mode and current Astro Workers guidance before changing configuration.

output_examples.input: Can I use the Cloudflare Vite plugin with React Router SPA mode?
output: The skill states that React Router SPA mode is not supported with the Cloudflare Vite plugin.
Check the current Workers guide and identify the application mode before selecting an integration.

best_practices: Inspect the installed framework version, rendering mode, adapter, and deployment configuration before making changes.
Use the matching framework guide and preserve established Wrangler configuration and the user's framework choice.
Review generated scripts, run framework checks and builds, and verify the Worker locally before deployment.
anti_patterns: Run cf initialization or deployment commands inside a project already configured for Wrangler.
Choose Pages templates for new Workers applications or change existing Pages deployments during unrelated maintenance.
Assume framework detection guarantees a successful build or skip local runtime verification.

faq.question: Which frameworks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It routes Astro, SvelteKit, React Router, TanStack Start, Nuxt, Hono, and React or Vue SPAs. Next.js uses a separate skill.

faq.question: Does it replace framework documentation?
faq.answer: No. It selects the relevant Workers guide and upstream framework guidance for the project.

faq.question: Will it switch an existing Wrangler project to cf?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly keeps Wrangler and prohibits cf initialization, development, build, and deployment commands in that project.

faq.question: Does it target Cloudflare Pages?
faq.answer: New applications target Workers. Existing Pages deployments should remain unchanged during unrelated maintenance.

faq.question: What must be checked before deployment?
faq.answer: Review generated package scripts, run framework checks and builds, and verify the Worker locally.

faq.question: Can the skill publish feedback without approval?
faq.answer: No. It requires sensitive information removal and approval of the exact public issue title and body before submission.
